general.description: Balanced evaluation across technical sharpness, dynamic range, noise, color, and composition

landscape.description: High priority on dynamic range headroom, fine edge sharpness, and horizon alignment

portrait.description: Prioritizes subject eye/face sharpness and clean skin tones; softer noise penalty

street.description: Focuses on composition, decisive moment contrast, and color vibe; tolerates higher noise

night.description: Strict noise control and highlight protection (city lights/stars) with shadow headroom
